physical_subject: Does a twenty-percent increase undo a twenty-percent decrease?
relationship: Successive percentage changes multiply their factors. The inverse of retaining0.8 is multiplying1.25, because percentage changes use the current base.
operation: One fixed-width water vessel keeps the original level marked while amounts change; the final half-empty case requires doubling the remainder.
closest_prior: Earlier percentage-flip arithmetic and varying water-height films
substantive_difference: This explains multiplicative reversal and changing reference amounts in a fixed-width container; it is not swapping a percent with its base or variable cross-sectional height.
